summary: Loma Negra filed its Form 6-K with its 2Q26 earnings release, reporting routine quarterly financial results. The filing includes net revenue, adjusted EBITDA, net profit, and net debt figures under IAS 29, with commentary from management on operational performance. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is mentioned.
